title: A Survey Study of the 3D Facial Landmark Detection Techniques Used as a Screening Tool for Diagnosis of the Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome.
figures: An example of an annotated lateral cephalogram showing all 19 landmark positions used by the authors in their study [ 17 ]. The authors aimed to develop and validate an automatic landmark annotation system.

The categorization of landmark identification techniques is presented in the study [ 26 ]. The authors have divided the techniques into two major categories: knowledge-based techniques and AI-based techniques.
